title.zh: 朱青妮 · 羁服与分批补弹
title.en: Zhu / Qingyi / Nicole · Subjugation and staged refills

summary.zh: 青衣准备失衡，妮可覆盖减防，朱鸢在窗口分批射击与补弹。
summary.en: Qingyi prepares Stun, Nicole covers the debuff, and Zhu Yuan spends/refills within the window.

conditions.zh: 按妮可→朱鸢→青衣的循环站位；仍以实际支援提示为准。
conditions.en: Use the cyclic order Nicole → Zhu Yuan → Qingyi; actual Assist prompts remain required.

conditions.zh: 采用基础正式技能；不计潜能觉醒、未知驱动盘或固定敌人失衡次数。
conditions.en: Uses released base skills, without Awakening, unspecified discs or fixed Stun/Chain counts.

conditions.zh: 首次进战有六枚霰弹；后续循环不会重新领取。
conditions.en: The initial entry grants six shells; later loops do not grant them again.

label.zh: HoYo青枫 · 朱鸢分批补弹
label.en: HoYo Qingfeng · Zhu Yuan ammo cycles

label.zh: 許可 · 支援站位说明

objective.zh: 先准备青衣电压，观察首次失衡机会。
objective.en: Build Qingyi’s Voltage and watch the first Stun opportunity.

title.zh: 有能量时，强化特殊技起手

input.zh: 点按强化特殊技，再接普攻第三段。
input.en: Press EX Special, then follow with Basic hit 3.

trigger.zh: 当前能量足够；本轮需要积电压。
trigger.en: Enough energy; Voltage needs building this cycle.

complete.zh: 确认下砸完成，衔接普攻第三段。
complete.en: Finish the slam and connect into Basic hit 3.

reason.zh: 作者建议用强化特殊技主动进入第三段，减少等待敌人攻击。
reason.en: The author uses EX to enter hit 3 without waiting for an enemy attack.

fallback.zh: 能量不足直接用普攻进入第三段；不假定开局有能量。
fallback.en: Without energy, reach hit 3 through Basic Attacks; starting energy is not assumed.

title.zh: 第三段连打，观察电压与敌人
title.en: Repeat hit 3; watch Voltage and the enemy

input.zh: 连续点按普攻；遇攻击时按实际时机闪避反击。
input.en: Repeat Basic inputs; Dodge Counter at the actual attack cue.

trigger.zh: 青衣可安全站场，且需要积蓄闪络电压。
trigger.en: Qingyi can act safely and still needs Flash Connect Voltage.

complete.zh: 实际电压达到75%进入闪络，再转长按分支。
complete.en: At an actual 75% Voltage, enter Flash Connect and use the held branch.

reason.zh: 电压依赖命中；躲避后可以接回第三段，不把一套动作算作自动充满。
reason.en: Voltage depends on hits. Return to hit 3 after a counter; one string does not guarantee a full gauge.

fallback.zh: 敌人进攻先闪避；若M1开局电压已满，可跳过这段积蓄。
fallback.en: Dodge incoming attacks. Skip this buildup if M1 opening Voltage is already full.

title.zh: 闪络长按，完成终结一击
title.en: Flash Connect: complete the held finisher

input.zh: 闪络时长按普攻；按敌人攻击时机决定松手。
input.en: Hold Basic during Flash Connect; release in response to the actual attack.

trigger.zh: 闪络电压≥75%；目标仍可命中。
trigger.en: At least 75% Voltage and a hittable target.

complete.zh: 终结一击实际命中，确认羁服和失衡；需要突进层数时先完成对应突进。
complete.en: Land the finisher and check Subjugation/Stun; complete the lunges needed for your stack plan first.

reason.zh: 羁服由终结一击施加；提前松手会提前终结，不能把未打出的突进算入叠层。
reason.en: Subjugation comes from the finisher. Early release ends the lunges; unperformed lunges add no stacks.

fallback.zh: 电压不足回第三段；被打断或目标移开时重新检查，不按固定次数认定已失衡。
fallback.en: Return to hit 3 if Voltage is short. Recheck after interruption or movement; a fixed number of casts does not guarantee Stun.

signal.zh: 确认终结命中且可换人，再切妮可。
signal.en: After the finisher lands and switching is available, switch to Nicole.

title.zh: 妮可补能量场，等朱鸢快支
title.en: Nicole field, then Zhu Yuan Quick Assist

input.zh: 能量足够时发动强化特殊技。
input.en: Use EX Special when energy permits.

trigger.zh: 能量足够、目标在范围内；需要刷新减防。
trigger.en: Enough energy, target in range, and the debuff needs refreshing.

complete.zh: 能量场实际命中；朱鸢的快速支援提示出现后接手。
complete.en: The field hits; respond only after Zhu Yuan’s Quick Assist prompt appears.

reason.zh: 减防来自命中，不是切入妮可就生效；站位要求妮可后接朱鸢。
reason.en: The hit applies the debuff, not Nicole entering. Zhu Yuan must follow Nicole in slot order.

fallback.zh: 无能量则先恢复或等实际连携；提示不是朱鸢时检查站位，不把普通切人算作快支。
fallback.en: Recover energy or use an available Chain. If the prompt is not Zhu Yuan, check slots; normal switching is not Quick Assist.

signal.zh: 按实际朱鸢快支提示入场。
signal.en: Enter through the actual Zhu Yuan Quick Assist prompt.

title.zh: 朱鸢快支补一枚，再看失衡
title.en: Quick Assist adds one shell; check Stun

input.zh: 在妮可触发的朱鸢快速支援提示下按支援键。
input.en: Press Assist at Zhu Yuan’s Quick Assist prompt triggered by Nicole.

trigger.zh: 对应提示实际存在；队伍站位正确。
trigger.en: The matching prompt is visible and slot order is correct.

complete.zh: 确认快速支援发动并获得一枚强化霰弹；进入实际失衡则转爆发段。
complete.en: Confirm Quick Assist and its one Enhanced Shotshell. Enter the burst phase if Stun has actually begun.

reason.zh: 这是有条件的补弹入口；未失衡时把时间还给青衣，避免朱鸢长期无目的站场。
reason.en: This is a conditional ammo source. Outside Stun, give field time back to Qingyi rather than keeping Zhu Yuan on field without a purpose.

fallback.zh: 没有提示就跳过快支，不自行补记弹药；霰弹不足可先用突击普攻第四/五段补充。
fallback.en: Without the prompt, skip and do not credit ammo. Assault Basic hits 4/5 can refill shortages.

objective.zh: 失衡外由青衣推进，按需补妮可状态与朱鸢弹药。
objective.en: Outside Stun, advance Qingyi’s setup and refresh Nicole/ammo as needed.

objective.zh: 减防覆盖后，现有霰弹先打，再分批补。
objective.en: With the debuff active, spend existing ammo before staged refills.

prep.zh: 连携数量不固定；若只允许妮可一次连携，改用她触发的朱鸢快支接手。
prep.en: Chain count varies. If only Nicole’s Chain is available, enter Zhu Yuan through its actual Quick Assist prompt.

title.zh: 连携先让妮可能量场命中
title.en: Land Nicole’s field before the damage entry

input.zh: 在实际连携提示中选择妮可。
input.en: Select Nicole at the actual Chain Attack prompt.

trigger.zh: 敌人已经失衡，妮可连携可选；本分支用于仍有后续朱鸢连携机会的情况。
trigger.en: Enemy Stunned, Nicole Chain available, and a following Zhu Yuan Chain opportunity remains.

complete.zh: 能量场命中后，在后续提示中选择朱鸢。
complete.en: After the field hits, select Zhu Yuan at the following prompt.

reason.zh: 先覆盖减防再交给朱鸢；连携次数受实际敌人和界面限制。
reason.en: Cover the debuff before Zhu Yuan. Actual enemy/prompt rules limit Chain count.

fallback.zh: 只够一次连携或无朱鸢选项时，用实际朱鸢快支接手（见循环段）；不得虚构额外连携。
fallback.en: With only one Chain or no Zhu Yuan choice, use the actual Zhu Yuan Quick Assist as shown in the loop; do not invent another Chain.

signal.zh: 仅实际后续提示允许时选朱鸢连携。
signal.en: Select Zhu Yuan Chain only when the following prompt allows it.

title.zh: 朱鸢连携补三枚，保留前台
title.en: Zhu Yuan Chain: add three shells and stay on field

input.zh: 在可用的连携提示选择朱鸢。
input.en: Select Zhu Yuan at the available Chain prompt.

trigger.zh: 朱鸢连携实际可选；弹药按真实剩余量读取。
trigger.en: Zhu Yuan Chain is available; read actual remaining ammo.

complete.zh: 连携发动补三枚；结束可选连携后由朱鸢输出。
complete.en: Chain grants three shells; finish the selected Chain sequence with Zhu Yuan dealing damage.

reason.zh: 尽量在补弹前留容量；这不是固定三连携或必选邦布轴。
reason.en: Leave ammo capacity before refilling. This is not a mandatory three-Chain/Bangboo sequence.

fallback.zh: 没有连携提示则不执行；通过对应快支入场时只按快支实际补弹量计算。
fallback.en: Do not execute without a Chain prompt. A Quick Assist entry grants only its own actual ammo.

title.zh: 压制射击消耗现有霰弹
title.en: Spend current shells in Suppressive Mode

input.zh: 长按普攻；需要时用方向键调整身位。
input.en: Hold Basic and use movement inputs to reposition if needed.

trigger.zh: 至少有一枚强化霰弹；目标可命中，当前增益及窗口仍有效。
trigger.en: At least one Enhanced Shotshell; target hittable and the buff/window still active.

complete.zh: 观察实际剩余弹药再补弹，避免满弹时连续堆叠补弹招式。
complete.en: Read remaining ammo before refilling; avoid stacking refill skills at full capacity.

reason.zh: 分批打出与补回可减少弹药溢出；不固定假定每个窗口能打完所有步骤。
reason.en: Spending before refilling reduces overcap. The full sequence is not assumed to fit every window.

fallback.zh: 没弹先选当前可用的补弹招式；窗口结束就回常态循环。
fallback.en: Without shells, use an available refill. Return to the loop when the window ends.

title.en: Use a ready Ultimate to refill

input.zh: 朱鸢终结技可用时点按终结技。
input.en: Press Zhu Yuan’s Ultimate when ready.

trigger.zh: 朱鸢自己的终结技已就绪，窗口仍在，弹药有容量。
trigger.en: Zhu Yuan’s own Ultimate is ready, the window remains, and ammo has room.

complete.zh: 发动后实际补三枚霰弹；M1的快速装填效果另按耗尽弹药触发。
complete.en: Gain the actual three shells on use; M1 Quick Reload separately waits for ammo depletion.

reason.zh: 本段只检查朱鸢自己的就绪状态，未采用旧版全队共用喧响。
reason.en: Only Zhu Yuan’s own readiness is checked; the old shared-Decibel rule is not used.

fallback.zh: 未就绪或窗口不足则跳过，不原地空等。
fallback.en: Skip if unavailable or the window is too short; do not wait idle.

input.zh: 能量足够时点按强化特殊技。
input.en: Press EX Special with enough energy.

trigger.zh: 能量足够、仍有输出机会；若已接近满弹先消耗再补。
trigger.en: Enough energy and an output opportunity; spend first if near full ammo.

complete.zh: 发动后获得三枚霰弹，下一步继续压制射击。
complete.en: Gain three shells, then resume Suppressive fire.

reason.zh: 专武持有时该招触发充能；无专武仍可执行基础补弹。
reason.en: With the signature, this activates its charges. The base refill also works without it.

fallback.zh: 能量不足跳过；M6减费也必须先累计满足消耗条件。
fallback.en: Skip if energy is short; M6 cost reduction still requires its prior shell-consumption condition.

title.zh: 压制射击消耗现有霰弹
title.en: Spend current shells in Suppressive Mode

input.zh: 长按普攻；需要时用方向键调整身位。

fallback.en: Without shells, use an available refill. Return to the loop when the window ends.

text.zh: 青衣M1首次进战满电压，可跳过开局攒电；后续不是每轮自动回满。满电压发动的附加效果另看实际条件。
text.en: Qingyi M1 starts with full Voltage, allowing opening buildup to be skipped; it does not refill every loop. Full-Voltage bonuses keep their own condition.

text.zh: 朱鸢M1是先取得快速装填，耗尽霰弹后才补6/9枚；不要把连携/Q当作立即额外补满。
text.en: Zhu Yuan M1 grants Quick Reload first; its six/nine-shell refill waits for depletion. Chain/Ultimate does not instantly add that full refill.

text.zh: 累计消耗12枚霰弹取得以太余温后，下次强化特殊技才减费；恢复分支不得提前计入。
text.en: After consuming 12 shells, Ether Afterglow discounts the next EX. Do not credit that discount before its condition.

text.zh: 防暴者Ⅵ型靠强化特殊技取得充能；需要专武效果时在射击前确认充能，不能只用连携就假定已触发。
text.en: Riot Suppressor gains charges from EX Special. Check charges before shooting; Chain alone does not activate them.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.第三段连打，观察电压与敌人: 连点普攻第三段，观察电压
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.闪络长按，完成终结一击: 闪络时长按普攻，打完最后一击
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.妮可补能量场，等朱鸢快支: 强化特殊技命中后看快支提示
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.朱鸢快支补一枚，再看失衡: 按快支入场，补一枚霰弹
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.连携先让妮可能量场命中: 连携选妮可，让能量场命中
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.朱鸢连携补三枚，保留前台: 连携选朱鸢，补三枚霰弹
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.强化特殊技补弹: 有能量时按强化特殊技补弹

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.能量足够时发动强化特殊技。: 能量够时按强化特殊技，让能量场命中目标。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1031: 需要补能量场且能量够时，点按强化特殊技并命中；尚未出现连携窗口就不要按连携选人。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.103100004: 能量够时点按强化特殊技，等能量场命中

124100002: 本步要长按普攻打压制攻击。何时停看实际弹量，不是要点到固定段数才可按强化特殊技。
Hold Basic for Suppressive Mode here. Stop by actual shell count; a fixed Basic hit number is not an EX prerequisite.
125100001: 本步用普攻积闪络电压；进入第三段后持续点按维持连击，按当前连段衔接。
Build voltage with Basics. Once in hit 3, keep tapping Basic to sustain the string.
125100004: 闪络状态下长按普攻打突进终结；长按是发动键，不是先普攻若干下。
Hold Basic in Flash Connect for the advancing finisher. The hold activates it; no counted preliminary taps.
125100006: 本步若用强化特殊技，先放再点普攻直达第三段；已在第三段且只需维持连击时无需为接段重放。
If using EX, cast it first, then tap Basic to enter hit 3 directly. If already sustaining hit 3, EX is not needed to enter it again.

1241: 普攻补弹路线看突击第四或第五段是否命中；能量够时也可直接用强化特殊技补弹，不必把两路都打。
For Basic ammo recovery, land Assault Mode hit 4 or 5. With Energy, EX can reload instead; do not require both.
